def make_grid(boundaries, interior, tail):
    size = boundaries*(interior+1) + tail
    g = [[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
    for k in range(boundaries):
        wall = (interior+1)*k + interior
        for q in range(size):
            g[wall][q] = 8; g[q][wall] = 8
    return g

def add_marks(g, step, marks, offset=(1,1)):
    for r,c,v in marks:
        g[step*r+offset[0]][step*c+offset[1]] = v
    return g

def fill_rooms(g, step, cells, value):
    for i,j in cells:
        for r in range(step*i, step*i+step-1):
            for c in range(step*j, step*j+step-1): g[r][c]=value

# Demo 1
D1=make_grid(5,3,2)
add_marks(D1,4,[(0,1,2),(4,1,2),(2,0,3),(2,4,3)])
E1=[row[:] for row in D1]
fill_rooms(E1,4,[(i,1) for i in range(5)],2)
fill_rooms(E1,4,[(2,j) for j in range(5)],3)
fill_rooms(E1,4,[(2,1)],6)
A1=mod.transform(D1)
print('demo1', A1==E1)
# Demo 2
D2=make_grid(8,2,0)
add_marks(D2,3,[(0,3,2),(1,1,3),(1,6,3),(4,6,2),(6,3,2),(6,6,2)],offset=(0,0))
E2=[row[:] for row in D2]
rooms2col3=[(i,3) for i in range(7)]
rooms2col6=[(i,6) for i in range(4,7)]
rooms2row6=[(6,j) for j in range(3,7)]
rooms3row1=[(1,j) for j in range(1,7)]
fill_rooms(E2,3,rooms2col3+rooms2col6+rooms2row6,2)
fill_rooms(E2,3,rooms3row1,3)
fill_rooms(E2,3,[(1,3)],6)
A2=mod.transform(D2)
print('demo2', A2==E2)
if A2!=E2: print('diffs2',[(r,c,A2[r][c],E2[r][c]) for r in range(24) for c in range(24) if A2[r][c]!=E2[r][c]][:30])
